el-salvador.title: Flag of the Republic of El Salvador

colors.note: Upper and lower bands; represents the sky and the two oceans bordering Central America.
Central band bearing the coat of arms; represents peace.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of blue, white, and blue, with the national coat of arms centred on the white band
- The coat of arms features a triangle (equality), five volcanoes (the Central American federation), a Phrygian cap, and the motto Dios Union Libertad
- Adopted on 17 September 1912, restoring the colours of the United Provinces of Central America
trivia:
- The blue-white-blue pattern is shared with Argentina, Honduras, and Nicaragua, all descended from the flag of the United Provinces of Central America
- The five volcanoes on the coat of arms represent the original five states of the Central American federation
- The civil flag bears the inscription Dios Union Libertad (God Union Liberty) in gold instead of the full coat of arms
